targetSelector.description: Names of the workloads that use this service account.

enabled.description: Create this ServiceAccount when true. Accepts a Helm `tpl` string that renders to `true` or `false`.

primary.description: Mark this service account as the primary one, used by workloads that select none.

namespace.description: Namespace to create this object in. Overrides the chart-wide `namespace` and `global.namespace`.

annotationsList.description: Additional annotations as a list of name and value pairs, merged into the annotations

labelsList.description: Additional labels as a list of name and value pairs, merged into the labels

targetSelectAll.description: Use this service account for all workloads.

automountServiceAccountToken.description: Whether pods automatically mount the API token of this service account.
